name: 3d Transition-Metal Spin-State Benchmark
description: A benchmark of spin-state splitting energies in 3d transition-metal complexes intended to assess and calibrate electronic-structure methods.
typical_sota_score: 1–10 kcal/mol (MAE range depending on method and system)
reputation: A niche but respected benchmark within the computational chemistry community for assessing and calibrating electronic-structure methods on 3d transition-metal spin-state energetics.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; small and specialized dataset. Results are highly sensitive to the chosen reference method, basis sets, and relativistic/correlation treatments; evaluations can be computationally expensive.
